 SAN ANTONIO — As steady rain continues throughout much of South Central Texas Sunday into the early week, we want to see your photos and videos capturing the downpour.
 According to the National Weather Service, periods of light to moderate rain are expected to last through early Tuesday. Rainfall totals are expected to be in the 1 to 4 inch range with pockets of higher amounts up to 6 inches. 
 Threat for flooding across most areas remains low however minor river/creek levels could rise. Be sure to avoid closed low water crossings and keep up with the latest closures here . 
 Be sure to share your rain photos/videos via Chime In . You could see your content on-air and online!
 Get the latest weathercast and view our interactive radar here . 
 TODAY 
 Soaking rainfall through much of the day. Pockets of moderate to heavy rain at times. Ponding on roadways likely. Temps in upper 50s to low 60s. Isolated areas of flooding possible.
 FLOOD WATCH for La Salle, McMullen and Goliad Counties.
 MONDAY 
 Waves of rain through the day. Low 60s.
 *Through Monday evening, a general 1-3" rain across most of the area. Pockets of 3-5+" likely in isolated locations.
 TUESDAY 
 Mostly cloudy with an isolated rain chance. Temps near 70.
 REST OF THE WEEK 
 Sun returns. Low to mid 70s.
